content.content:
1	extends Node3D
2	## A6 Effect A frame-strip preview (CHANGE-BRIEF §E). FIXTURE: loads the real slice (level art, sky, string lights,
3	## Hari, the in-game camera rig), holds the clock at 10:00 PM, stands Hari still at the dark gate or under the warm
4	## bulbs, hides the HUD, and spawns a FootstepScuff at Hari's floor position on frame 10 (and frame 21 with
5	## `retrigger`). The scuff's particles use a fixed seed here only, so before/after strips are comparable; the effect
6	## scene itself never sets one (repeats in play must vary).
7	
8	const SLICE := preload("res://scenes/slice.tscn")
9	const SCUFF := preload("res://effects/footstep_scuff.tscn")
10	const HARI_DARK_GATE := Vector3(3.5, 0.0, 1.0)   # §0: the darkest stretch is the gate end (x < 5)
11	const HARI_UNDER_BULBS := Vector3(12.0, 0.0, 1.0) # §0: under the string lights, middle span
12	const HELD_CLOCK := 22 * 60                       # 10:00 PM, the A5 judging time; no timeline event before 1:20 AM
13	const TRIGGER_FRAME_FIRST := 10
14	const TRIGGER_FRAME_SECOND := 21                  # §E, 11 frames after the first (one real step at 30 fps)
15	const PREVIEW_SEED := 6
16	
17	@export var lit: bool = false                     # false = dark gate, true = under the warm string lights
18	@export var retrigger: bool = false               # on = a second scuff at frame 21 while the first is still alive
19	
20	var slice: Node3D
21	var _frame := 0
22	
23	func _ready() -> void:

163		check("%s scale_amount_curve set" % name, c != null, c)
164		if c == null:
165			return
166		check("%s scale_amount_curve.max_value >= %.2f (so peak isn't clipped, §A.3 note)"
167				% [name, want_max],
168			c.max_value + EPS >= want_max, c.max_value)
169		check("%s scale_amount_curve has %d points" % [name, want_points.size()],
170			c.get_point_count() == want_points.size(), c.get_point_count())
171		for i in want_points.size():
172			var want: Vector2 = want_points[i]
173			var got := Vector2(c.get_point_position(i).x, c.get_point_position(i).y)
174			check("%s scale_amount_curve[%d] = (life %.2f, scale %.2f)"
175					% [name, i, want.x, want.y],
176				got.is_equal_approx(want), got)
177	
178	func _check_color_ramp(cp: CPUParticles3D, name: String, want: Array) -> void:
179		var g := cp.color_ramp as Gradient
180		check("%s color_ramp set" % name, g != null, g)
181		if g == null:
182			return
183		check("%s color_ramp has %d stops" % [name, want.size()],
184			g.get_point_count() == want.size(), g.get_point_count())
185		for i in want.size():
186			var row: Array = want[i]
187			var want_t: float = row[0]
188			var want_c: Color = row[1]
189			var want_a: float = row[2]
190			var got_t: float = g.get_offset(i)
191			var got_c: Color = g.get_color(i)
192			check("%s color_ramp[%d] offset = %.2f" % [name, i, want_t],
193				is_equal_approx(got_t, want_t), got_t)
194			# Colour and alpha both live in the Gradient's Color values (CPUParticles3D has no alpha_curve in 4.7.2).
195			check("%s color_ramp[%d] rgb within 1/255 of %s" % [name, i, _hex6(want_c)],
196				_rgb_close(got_c, want_c), got_c)
197			check("%s color_ramp[%d] alpha = %.2f" % [name, i, want_a],
198				is_equal_approx(got_c.a, want_a), got_c.a)
199	
200	func _rgb_close(a: Color, b: Color) -> bool:
201		# One 8-bit step = 1/255 ≈ 0.00392. Allow half a step.
202		var tol := 0.5 / 255.0
203		return absf(a.r - b.r) <= tol and absf(a.g - b.g) <= tol and absf(a.b - b.b) <= tol
204	
205	func _hex6(c: Color) -> String:
206		return "#%02X%02X%02X" % [int(round(c.r * 255.0)), int(round(c.g * 255.0)), int(round(c.b * 255.0))]
207

## A6 Effect A configuration read-back (CHANGE-BRIEF §A.3, §A.4).
## Loads res://effects/footstep_scuff.tscn and asserts every setting the brief names, using the

const EPS := 1.0e-5

	var ps: PackedScene = load(SCENE)

		"avmin": -60.0, "avmax": 60.0,

	})

	_check_scale_curve(soft, "SoftDust", [

	check("%s damping_max = %.2f" % [name, want["dmax"]],
		is_equal_approx(cp.damping_max, want["dmax"]), cp.damping_max)
	check("%s scale_amount_min = %.2f" % [name, want["smin"]],

		is_equal_approx(cp.hue_variation_min, -0.02), cp.hue_variation_min)
	check("%s hue_variation_max = +0.02" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.hue_variation_max, 0.02), cp.hue_variation_max)

	# Draw
	var mesh := cp.mesh as QuadMesh
	check("%s mesh is QuadMesh" % name, mesh != null, cp.mesh)
	if mesh != null:
		check("%s quad size = %s m" % [name, want["quad_size"]],
			mesh.size.is_equal_approx(want["quad_size"]), mesh.size)
		var mat := mesh.material as StandardMaterial3D
		check("%s material is StandardMaterial3D" % name, mat != null, mesh.material)
		if mat != null:
			check("%s material.transparency = ALPHA (1)" % name,
				mat.transparency == BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA, mat.transparency)
			check("%s material.blend_mode = MIX (0)" % name,
				mat.blend_mode == BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_MIX, mat.blend_mode)
			check("%s material.shading_mode = UNSHADED (0)" % name,
				mat.shading_mode == BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED, mat.shading_mode)
			check("%s material.billboard_mode = BILLBOARD_PARTICLES (3)" % name,
				mat.billboard_mode == BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES, mat.billboard_mode)
			check("%s material.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true" % name,
				mat.vertex_color_use_as_albedo == true, mat.vertex_color_use_as_albedo)
			check("%s material.albedo_texture is a procedural GradientTexture2D" % name,
				mat.albedo_texture != null and mat.albedo_texture is GradientTexture2D, mat.albedo_texture)

	# Node settings
	check("%s local_coords = false (dust stays at footprint)" % name,
		cp.local_coords == false, cp.local_coords)
	check("%s preprocess = 0.0 s" % name, is_equal_approx(cp.preprocess, 0.0), cp.preprocess)
	check("%s speed_scale = 1.0" % name, is_equal_approx(cp.speed_scale, 1.0), cp.speed_scale)
	check("%s visibility_aabb = AABB((-0.6,-0.1,-0.6),(1.2,0.6,1.2))" % name,
		cp.visibility_aabb == AABB(Vector3(-0.6, -0.1, -0.6), Vector3(1.2, 0.6, 1.2)),
		cp.visibility_aabb)
	check("%s process_mode = PAUSABLE (1)" % name,
		cp.process_mode == Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE, cp.process_mode)
	# Emitter 0.03 m above the root so the root sits on the floor at Hari's feet.
	check("%s transform.origin = (0, 0.03, 0)" % name,
		cp.transform.origin.is_equal_approx(Vector3(0, 0.03, 0)), cp.transform.origin)

func _check_scale_curve(cp: CPUParticles3D, name: String, want_points: Array, want_max: float) -> void:
	var c := cp.scale_amount_curve as Curve
	check("%s scale_amount_curve set" % name, c != null, c)
	if c == null:
		return
	check("%s scale_amount_curve.max_value >= %.2f (so peak isn't clipped, §A.3 note)"
			% [name, want_max],
		c.max_value + EPS >= want_max, c.max_value)
	check("%s scale_amount_curve has %d points" % [name, want_points.size()],
		c.get_point_count() == want_points.size(), c.get_point_count())
	for i in want_points.size():
		var want: Vector2 = want_points[i]
		var got := Vector2(c.get_point_position(i).x, c.get_point_position(i).y)
		check("%s scale_amount_curve[%d] = (life %.2f, scale %.2f)"
				% [name, i, want.x, want.y],
			got.is_equal_approx(want), got)

func _check_color_ramp(cp: CPUParticles3D, name: String, want: Array) -> void:
	var g := cp.color_ramp as Gradient
	check("%s color_ramp set" % name, g != null, g)
	if g == null:
		return
	check("%s color_ramp has %d stops" % [name, want.size()],
		g.get_point_count() == want.size(), g.get_point_count())
	for i in want.size():
		var row: Array = want[i]
		var want_t: float = row[0]
		var want_c: Color = row[1]
		var want_a: float = row[2]
		var got_t: float = g.get_offset(i)
		var got_c: Color = g.get_color(i)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] offset = %.2f" % [name, i, want_t],
			is_equal_approx(got_t, want_t), got_t)
		# Colour and alpha both live in the Gradient's Color values (CPUParticles3D has no alpha_curve in 4.7.2).
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] rgb within 1/255 of %s" % [name, i, _hex6(want_c)],
			_rgb_close(got_c, want_c), got_c)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] alpha = %.2f" % [name, i, want_a],
			is_equal_approx(got_c.a, want_a), got_c.a)

func _rgb_close(a: Color, b: Color) -> bool:
	# One 8-bit step = 1/255 ≈ 0.00392. Allow half a step.
	var tol := 0.5 / 255.0
	return absf(a.r - b.r) <= tol and absf(a.g - b.g) <= tol and absf(a.b - b.b) <= tol

func _hex6(c: Color) -> String:
	return "#%02X%02X%02X" % [int(round(c.r * 255.0)), int(round(c.g * 255.0)), int(round(c.b * 255.0))]

extends SceneTree
## Shared headless test helpers: frame stepping, key injection, PASS/FAIL bookkeeping.
## Tests drive the logic layer only (LoopState, Story, Controls, SoundBank autoloads);
## no presentation scene is needed. Run:  "$GODOT" --headless --path godot -s res://tests/<file>.gd

var ls: Node          # LoopState: clock, flags, timeline
var story: Node       # Story: dialogue, interaction latch, Hari's state
var sound: Node       # SoundBank: trigger_counts
var checks := 0
var failures := 0

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("_run_and_report")

func _run_and_report() -> void:
	await process_frame
	ls = root.get_node_or_null("LoopState")
	story = root.get_node_or_null("Story")
	sound = root.get_node_or_null("SoundBank")
	check("autoloads present", ls != null and story != null and sound != null and root.has_node("Controls"), "%s %s %s" % [ls, story, sound])
	# run() returns true only if it reached its end; a script error makes it return null.
	var completed: Variant = false
	if ls and story and sound:
		completed = await run()
	check("test script ran to completion", completed == true, completed)
	print("")
	var verdict := "PASS"
	if failures > 0:
		verdict = "FAIL"
	print("%s: %d checks, %d failed -> %s" % [get_script().resource_path.get_file(), checks, failures, verdict])
	quit(0 if failures == 0 else 1)

func run() -> bool:
	return true

func check(id: String, passed: bool, observed: Variant = "") -> void:
	checks += 1
	if not passed:
		failures += 1
	print("[%s] %s   %s" % ["PASS" if passed else "FAIL", id, str(observed)])

func steps(n: int) -> void:
	for i in n:
		await physics_frame
		await process_frame

func key(code: Key, pressed: bool, echo := false) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = code
	event.physical_keycode = code
	event.pressed = pressed
	event.echo = echo
	Input.parse_input_event(event)

func tap(code: Key, hold_frames := 1) -> void:
	key(code, true)
	await steps(hold_frames)
	key(code, false)
	await steps(1)

## 10 presses in 20 frames (~0.33 s): faster than any line or cooldown guard.
func mash(code: Key, presses := 10) -> void:
	for i in presses:
		key(code, true)
		await steps(1)
		key(code, false)
		await steps(1)

## Wait (real frames) until cond is true or `seconds` pass. Returns cond's final value.
func wait_until(cond: Callable, seconds: float) -> bool:
	var deadline := Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(seconds * 1000.0)
	while not cond.call() and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await steps(1)
	return cond.call()

## Advance any open dialogue with spaced E taps until it closes, then wait out any brief
## state (NOTES/KEYS/STARTLED) and the talk cooldown.
func finish_dialogue(max_taps := 20) -> void:
	for i in max_taps:
		if not story.dialogue_active:
			break
		await steps(10)     # past the per-line minimum display time
		await tap(KEY_E)
	await wait_until(func() -> bool: return not story.flash_active(), 5.0)
	await steps(30)         # a player takes longer than the 0.35 s talk cooldown to press again

## The presentation's side of the thin interface, stood in for by the test.
func stand_near(target: String, x := 4.5) -> void:
	story.nearby_target = target
	story.player_x = x

2	## Builds the simple-box set dressing: railing, pool walls, string-light poles, bulbs and lights.
3	## Layout numbers (metres) are constants here; the floor and water are textured nodes in the scene.
4	
5	const Art3D = preload("res://scenes/art3d.gd")
6	const DECK_LENGTH := 26.0
7	const DECK_HALF_DEPTH := 4.0
8	const RAILING_START_X := 20.0
9	const POOL := Rect2(9.0, -3.2, 7.0, 2.4)      ## x, z, size x, size z (the recess)
10	const POOL_DEPTH := 0.6
11	const LIGHT_XS := [6.0, 10.0, 14.0, 18.0]      ## string-light poles along the back of the deck
12	const LIGHT_Z := -3.6
13	const STRING_LIGHT_COLOR := Color(1.0, 0.66, 0.36)   ## ~2700 K
14	
15	func _ready() -> void:
16		var rail := Art3D.lit_material(Color("d8cbb5"))
17		# railing along the +x end and along +z for the railing zone
18		_box(Vector3(0.08, 0.08, DECK_HALF_DEPTH * 2), Vector3(DECK_LENGTH, 1.05, 0), rail)
19		_box(Vector3(DECK_LENGTH - RAILING_START_X, 0.08, 0.08), Vector3((DECK_LENGTH + RAILING_START_X) / 2.0, 1.05, DECK_HALF_DEPTH), rail)
20		for i in 9:
21			_box(Vector3(0.06, 1.05, 0.06), Vector3(DECK_LENGTH, 0.52, -DECK_HALF_DEPTH + i * 1.0), rail)
22		for i in 7:
23			_box(Vector3(0.06, 1.05, 0.06), Vector3(RAILING_START_X + i * 1.0, 0.52, DECK_HALF_DEPTH), rail)
24		# pool walls (the floor has a hole over POOL; water sits below)
25		var tile := Art3D.lit_material(Color("8fd3e0"))
26		var c := POOL.get_center()
27		_box(Vector3(POOL.size.x, POOL_DEPTH, 0.05), Vector3(c.x, -POOL_DEPTH / 2, POOL.position.y), tile)
28		_box(Vector3(POOL.size.x, POOL_DEPTH, 0.05), Vector3(c.x, -POOL_DEPTH / 2, POOL.end.y), tile)
29		_box(Vector3(0.05, POOL_DEPTH, POOL.size.y), Vector3(POOL.position.x, -POOL_DEPTH / 2, c.y), tile)
30		_box(Vector3(0.05, POOL_DEPTH, POOL.size.y), Vector3(POOL.end.x, -POOL_DEPTH / 2, c.y), tile)
31		# string lights: poles, a sagging row of emissive bulbs, and a warm OmniLight3D per span
32		var pole := Art3D.lit_material(Color("2b2530"))
33		var bulb := Art3D.lit_material(Color("ffd36b"), 4.0, Color("ffc46b"))
34		for i in LIGHT_XS.size():
35			var x: float = LIGHT_XS[i]
36			_box(Vector3(0.08, 3.2, 0.08), Vector3(x, 1.6, LIGHT_Z), pole)
37			if i + 1 < LIGHT_XS.size():
38				var next: float = LIGHT_XS[i + 1]
39				for s in range(1, 8):
40					var t := s / 8.0
41					_sphere(0.06, Vector3(lerpf(x, next, t), 3.1 - sin(t * PI) * 0.45, LIGHT_Z + 0.05), bulb)
42				var light := OmniLight3D.new()
43				light.light_color = STRING_LIGHT_COLOR
44				light.light_energy = 2.8
45				light.omni_range = 7.0
46				light.position = Vector3((x + next) / 2.0, 2.7, LIGHT_Z + 1.2)
47				add_child(light)
48	
49	func _box(size: Vector3, pos: Vector3, material: Material) -> void:
50		var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
51		var mesh := BoxMesh.new()
52		mesh.size = size
53		mi.mesh = mesh
54		mi.position = pos
55		mi.material_override = material
56		add_child(mi)
57	
58	func _sphere(radius: float, pos: Vector3, material: Material) -> void:
59		var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
60		var mesh := SphereMesh.new()
61		mesh.radius = radius
62		mesh.height = radius * 2.0
63		mesh.radial_segments = 8
64		mesh.rings = 4
65		mi.mesh = mesh
66		mi.position = pos
67		mi.material_override = material
68		add_child(mi)
69

status=$?
if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR" "$log"; then status=1; fi
exit $status

1	extends Node
2	## Game logic for the night: clock, loop counter, knowledge, per-loop flags and the timeline.
3	## Knows nothing about audio or about the 2D/3D presentation: those only listen to these signals
4	## and read the queries below. Story (dialogue/interaction) and Controls (keys) sit beside it.
5	## Every timeline event is latched by a per-loop flag, so it fires exactly once per loop.
6	
7	signal loop_started(loop_index: int)
8	signal phone_buzz
9	signal clue_saved(clue_id: String)
10	signal keys_exchanged(from_holder: String, to_holder: String)
11	signal advay_arrived(took_keys: bool)
12	signal fire_glow
13	signal dawn_crash
14	signal safe_dawn
15	signal slice_ended
16	signal pause_changed(paused: bool)
17	
18	enum Phase { NIGHT, CRASH, SAFE_DAWN, ENDED }
19	
20	# Clock values are minutes after midnight of the party day, so 1:30 AM = 25 * 60 + 30.
21	const NIGHT_START := 20 * 60              ## 8:00 PM
22	const NIGHT_END := 29 * 60 + 55           ## 5:55 AM
23	const NIGHT_REAL_SECONDS := 180.0         ## real seconds for the whole night at 1x
24	const FAST_FORWARD := 8.0                 ## hold T
25	const MINUTES_PER_SECOND := (NIGHT_END - NIGHT_START) / NIGHT_REAL_SECONDS
26	const OVERHEAR_START := 25 * 60 + 20      ## 1:20 AM, Manikandan calls Selvam
27	const ADVAY_TIME := 25 * 60 + 40          ## 1:40 AM, Advay comes for the keys
28	const MUSIC_THIN_START := 27 * 60         ## 3:00 AM, party music starts thinning
29	const FIRE_GLOW_TIME := 28 * 60 + 45      ## 4:45 AM
30	const DAWN_TIME := 29 * 60 + 50           ## 5:50 AM
31	const CRASH_RESET_DELAY := 4.0            ## real seconds from dawn_crash to the 8 PM reset
32	const END_CARD_DELAY := 3.0               ## real seconds from safe_dawn to the end card
33	const KNOWLEDGE := ["KNOW_SELVAM", "KNOW_KEYS"]
34	
35	var loop_index := 1
36	var knowledge := {}                       ## persists across loops
37	var notes: Array[String] = []             ## phone notes (clue ids), persist across loops
38	var flags := {}                           ## reset every loop
39	var clock_minutes := float(NIGHT_START)
40	var phase := Phase.NIGHT
41	var keys_holder := "car"                  ## car / manikandan / advay
42	var talking := false                      ## set by Story while a dialogue is open: freezes the clock
43	var fast_forward := false                 ## set by Controls while T is held

extends Node
## Game logic for the night: clock, loop counter, knowledge, per-loop flags and the timeline.
## Knows nothing about audio or about the 2D/3D presentation: those only listen to these signals
## and read the queries below. Story (dialogue/interaction) and Controls (keys) sit beside it.
## Every timeline event is latched by a per-loop flag, so it fires exactly once per loop.

signal loop_started(loop_index: int)
signal phone_buzz
signal clue_saved(clue_id: String)
signal keys_exchanged(from_holder: String, to_holder: String)
signal advay_arrived(took_keys: bool)
signal fire_glow
signal dawn_crash
signal safe_dawn
signal slice_ended
signal pause_changed(paused: bool)

enum Phase { NIGHT, CRASH, SAFE_DAWN, ENDED }

# Clock values are minutes after midnight of the party day, so 1:30 AM = 25 * 60 + 30.
const NIGHT_START := 20 * 60              ## 8:00 PM
const NIGHT_END := 29 * 60 + 55           ## 5:55 AM
const NIGHT_REAL_SECONDS := 180.0         ## real seconds for the whole night at 1x
const FAST_FORWARD := 8.0                 ## hold T
const MINUTES_PER_SECOND := (NIGHT_END - NIGHT_START) / NIGHT_REAL_SECONDS
const OVERHEAR_START := 25 * 60 + 20      ## 1:20 AM, Manikandan calls Selvam
const ADVAY_TIME := 25 * 60 + 40          ## 1:40 AM, Advay comes for the keys
const MUSIC_THIN_START := 27 * 60         ## 3:00 AM, party music starts thinning
const FIRE_GLOW_TIME := 28 * 60 + 45      ## 4:45 AM
const DAWN_TIME := 29 * 60 + 50           ## 5:50 AM
const CRASH_RESET_DELAY := 4.0            ## real seconds from dawn_crash to the 8 PM reset
const END_CARD_DELAY := 3.0               ## real seconds from safe_dawn to the end card
const KNOWLEDGE := ["KNOW_SELVAM", "KNOW_KEYS"]

var loop_index := 1
var knowledge := {}                       ## persists across loops
var notes: Array[String] = []             ## phone notes (clue ids), persist across loops
var flags := {}                           ## reset every loop
var clock_minutes := float(NIGHT_START)
var phase := Phase.NIGHT
var keys_holder := "car"                  ## car / manikandan / advay
var talking := false                      ## set by Story while a dialogue is open: freezes the clock
var fast_forward := false                 ## set by Controls while T is held
var running := false
var test_hold_clock := false              ## test-only: stop the clock from moving by itself
var _sequence_time := 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	_clear_knowledge()
	_reset_loop_flags()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not running:
		return
	match phase:
		Phase.NIGHT:
			if not talking and not test_hold_clock:
				var speed: float = FAST_FORWARD if fast_forward else 1.0
				_set_clock(clock_minutes + delta * MINUTES_PER_SECOND * speed)
		Phase.CRASH:
			_sequence_time += delta
			if _sequence_time >= CRASH_RESET_DELAY:
				start_loop(loop_index + 1)
		Phase.SAFE_DAWN:
			clock_minutes = minf(clock_minutes + delta * MINUTES_PER_SECOND, NIGHT_END)
			_sequence_time += delta
			if _sequence_time >= END_CARD_DELAY:
				phase = Phase.ENDED
				slice_ended.emit()

# --- loop control ---------------------------------------------------------------

## Fresh slice: loop 1 with all knowledge cleared (used at launch and by R on the end card).
func begin_slice() -> void:
	_clear_knowledge()
	start_loop(1)

func start_loop(index: int) -> void:
	loop_index = index
	_reset_loop_flags()
	clock_minutes = NIGHT_START
	phase = Phase.NIGHT
	keys_holder = "car"
	talking = false
	_sequence_time = 0.0
	running = true
	loop_started.emit(loop_index)
	phone_buzz.emit()

func set_paused(paused: bool) -> void:
	get_tree().paused = paused
	pause_changed.emit(paused)

func is_ended() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.ENDED

## Presentation queries (pure).
func manikandan_on_phone() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.NIGHT and clock_minutes >= OVERHEAR_START and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME

func advay_present() -> bool:
	return flags.ADVAY_DONE and phase != Phase.CRASH

# --- interactions ---------------------------------------------------------------

## Which conversation Manikandan offers right now. Pure query; changes nothing.
func manikandan_topic() -> String:
	if phase != Phase.NIGHT:
		return ""
	if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
		return "mani_keys_safe"
	if keys_holder == "advay":
		return "mani_after_advay"
	if ask_selvam_available():
		return "mani_choice"
	if clock_minutes >= OVERHEAR_START and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME:
		return "mani_overheard_again" if knowledge.KNOW_SELVAM else "mani_overhear"
	return "mani_generic"

## Hari talks to Manikandan. Returns the conversation id (changes nothing by itself).
func talk_to_manikandan() -> String:
	return manikandan_topic()

## Hari has listened to the whole Selvam call (Story calls this when mani_overhear closes).
## Saves the clue once; returns true if it was new.
func finish_overhearing() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.NIGHT and _learn("KNOW_SELVAM")

func ask_selvam_available() -> bool:
	return phase == Phase.NIGHT and loop_index >= 2 and knowledge.KNOW_SELVAM and knowledge.KNOW_KEYS \
		and clock_minutes < ADVAY_TIME and not flags.KEYS_SAFE

## The "Ask about Selvam" choice. Manikandan agrees to hold the keys. Returns false if not allowed.
func ask_about_selvam() -> bool:
	if not ask_selvam_available():
		return false
	flags.KEYS_SAFE = true
	var from := keys_holder
	keys_holder = "manikandan"
	keys_exchanged.emit(from, keys_holder)
	_save_note("KEYS_WITH_MANI")
	return true

# --- test-only API ----------------------------------------------------------------

## Jump the clock forward to `minutes` and run every timeline event on the way, in order.
func test_advance_to(minutes: float) -> void:
	if phase == Phase.NIGHT:
		_set_clock(maxf(minutes, clock_minutes))

## Finish the running dawn sequence now instead of waiting for its real-time delay.
func test_skip_sequence() -> void:
	_sequence_time = 1000.0
	_process(0.0)

func test_setup(index: int, known: Dictionary) -> void:
	_clear_knowledge()
	for id in known:
		knowledge[id] = known[id]
	start_loop(index)

# --- internals --------------------------------------------------------------------

func _set_clock(minutes: float) -> void:
	clock_minutes = minf(minutes, NIGHT_END)
	if clock_minutes >= ADVAY_TIME and not flags.ADVAY_DONE:
		flags.ADVAY_DONE = true
		_advay_arrives()
	if clock_minutes >= FIRE_GLOW_TIME and not flags.FIRE_GLOW_DONE:
		flags.FIRE_GLOW_DONE = true
		fire_glow.emit()
	if clock_minutes >= DAWN_TIME and not flags.DAWN_DONE:
		flags.DAWN_DONE = true
		clock_minutes = DAWN_TIME
		_dawn()

func _advay_arrives() -> void:
	if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
		advay_arrived.emit(false)
		return
	var from := keys_holder
	keys_holder = "advay"
	advay_arrived.emit(true)
	keys_exchanged.emit(from, keys_holder)
	_learn("KNOW_KEYS")

func _dawn() -> void:
	_sequence_time = 0.0
	if flags.KEYS_SAFE:
		phase = Phase.SAFE_DAWN
		safe_dawn.emit()
	else:
		phase = Phase.CRASH
		dawn_crash.emit()

func _learn(id: String) -> bool:
	if knowledge.get(id, false):
		return false
	knowledge[id] = true
	_save_note(id)
	return true

func _save_note(id: String) -> void:
	if id in notes:
		return
	notes.append(id)
	clue_saved.emit(id)

func _clear_knowledge() -> void:
	knowledge.clear()
	for id in KNOWLEDGE:
		knowledge[id] = false
	notes.clear()

func _reset_loop_flags() -> void:
	flags = {"KEYS_SAFE": false, "ADVAY_DONE": false, "FIRE_GLOW_DONE": false, "DAWN_DONE": false}

1	extends Node3D
2	## Telltale-style follow camera: damped follow of Hari with per-zone framing presets
3	## blended smoothly by Hari's x. Presets are data: offset from Hari, look-at offset, FOV.
4	
5	const PRESETS := {
6		"gate": {"offset": Vector3(2.4, 2.0, 3.1), "look": Vector3(-0.6, 1.1, -1.8), "fov": 54.0},     # on the deck, looking at the SUV and villa (playtest 3: the old preset sat off the deck and framed the wall)
7		"deck": {"offset": Vector3(0.0, 1.9, 4.5), "look": Vector3(0.0, 1.25, 0.0), "fov": 45.0},      # medium
8		"railing": {"offset": Vector3(-2.6, 1.8, -2.6), "look": Vector3(2.6, 1.0, 3.2), "fov": 50.0},  # swings past Hari to the sea
9	}
10	const GATE_END_X := 5.0
11	const RAILING_START_X := 20.0
12	const BLEND_HALF_WIDTH := 1.5           ## m either side of a zone boundary
13	const FOLLOW_SHARPNESS := 4.5           ## higher = snappier damping
14	const CAMERA_Z_RANGE := Vector2(-5.5, 9.0)
15	
16	@export var target_path: NodePath
17	var target: Node3D
18	var shake := 0.0                         ## seconds of shake left
19	var _look := Vector3.ZERO
20	@onready var camera: Camera3D = $Camera
21	
22	func _ready() -> void:
23		target = get_node(target_path)
24		snap()
25	
26	## Blend weights for the three presets at x.
27	static func zone_weights(x: float) -> Dictionary:
28		var to_deck := smoothstep(GATE_END_X - BLEND_HALF_WIDTH, GATE_END_X + BLEND_HALF_WIDTH, x)
29		var to_rail := smoothstep(RAILING_START_X - BLEND_HALF_WIDTH, RAILING_START_X + BLEND_HALF_WIDTH, x)
30		return {"gate": 1.0 - to_deck, "deck": to_deck * (1.0 - to_rail), "railing": to_rail}
31	
32	func _target_pos() -> Vector3:
33		return target.get_global_transform_interpolated().origin   # physics interpolation: smooth at any display rate
34	
35	func desired() -> Array:
36		var tp := _target_pos()
37		var weights := zone_weights(tp.x)
38		var offset := Vector3.ZERO
39		var look := Vector3.ZERO
40		var fov := 0.0

python3 -I -c '
import struct, zlib, math
W, H = 64, 40
rows = []
for y in range(H):
    row = bytearray([0])
    for x in range(W):
        nx = (x + 0.5 - W * 0.5) / (W * 0.5)
        ny = (y + 0.5 - H * 0.5) / (H * 0.5)
        left_dx = nx + 0.42
        right_dx = nx - 0.42
        wy = ny - 0.05
        left_d  = math.sqrt(left_dx*left_dx*6.0  + wy*wy*3.2)
        right_d = math.sqrt(right_dx*right_dx*6.0 + wy*wy*3.2)
        wing = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - min(left_d, right_d)))
        wing *= wing
        body_d = math.sqrt(nx*nx*70.0 + ny*ny*5.5)
        body = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - body_d))
        alpha = max(0.0, min(1.0, wing + body))
        if alpha <= 0.02:
            row += bytes([0,0,0,0]); continue
        body_w = body / (body + wing + 0.0001)
        gray = 1.0*(1.0-body_w) + 0.32*body_w
        g = int(round(gray*255)); a = int(round(alpha*255))
        row += bytes([g,g,g,a])
    rows.append(bytes(row))
raw = b"".join(rows)
def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack(">I", len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(t+d) & 0xffffffff)
sig = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
ihdr = struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", W, H, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0)
idat = zlib.compress(raw, 9)
png = sig + chunk(b"IHDR", ihdr) + chunk(b"IDAT", idat) + chunk(b"IEND", b"")
open("godot/effects/moth.png","wb").write(png)
print("wrote godot/effects/moth.png", W, "x", H, len(png), "bytes")
'

		var want_t: float = row[0]
		var want_c: Color = row[1]
		var want_a: float = row[2]

		var got_c := g.get_color(i)

			is_equal_approx(got_t, want_t), got_t)

func _check_attractor(at: GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D, name: String, want_pos: Vector3) -> void:

	check("%s radius = 1.0" % name, is_equal_approx(at.radius, 1.0), at.radius)
	check("%s strength = 0.30" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.strength, 0.30), at.strength)
	check("%s attenuation = 1.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.attenuation, 1.0), at.attenuation)
	check("%s directionality = 0.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.directionality, 0.0), at.directionality)
	check("%s cull_mask = 4294967295 (all layers; won't affect Effect A CPU particles)" % name,
		at.cull_mask == 4294967295, at.cull_mask)

func _rgb_close(a: Color, b: Color) -> bool:
	var tol := 0.5 / 255.0
	return absf(a.r - b.r) <= tol and absf(a.g - b.g) <= tol and absf(a.b - b.b) <= tol

func _hex6(c: Color) -> String:
	return "#%02X%02X%02X" % [int(round(c.r * 255.0)), int(round(c.g * 255.0)), int(round(c.b * 255.0))]

func _check_scale_curve(pm: ParticleProcessMaterial, name: String) -> void:
	# ParticleProcessMaterial wraps the Curve in a CurveTexture.
	var tex := pm.scale_curve as CurveTexture
	check("%s pm.scale_curve is CurveTexture" % name, tex != null, pm.scale_curve)
	if tex == null:
		return
	var c := tex.curve as Curve
	check("%s pm.scale_curve.curve is Curve" % name, c != null, tex.curve)
	if c == null:
		return
	var want: Array[Vector2] = [
		Vector2(0.0, 0.7), Vector2(0.15, 1.0), Vector2(0.75, 1.0), Vector2(1.0, 0.6),
	]
	check("%s scale_curve has %d points" % [name, want.size()],
		c.get_point_count() == want.size(), c.get_point_count())
	for i in want.size():
		var w: Vector2 = want[i]
		var g := c.get_point_position(i)
		check("%s scale_curve[%d] = (life %.2f, scale %.2f)" % [name, i, w.x, w.y],
			g.is_equal_approx(w), g)

func _check_color_ramp(pm: ParticleProcessMaterial, name: String) -> void:
	# ParticleProcessMaterial wraps the Gradient in a GradientTexture1D.
	var tex := pm.color_ramp as GradientTexture1D
	check("%s pm.color_ramp is GradientTexture1D" % name, tex != null, pm.color_ramp)
	if tex == null:
		return
	var g := tex.gradient as Gradient
	check("%s pm.color_ramp.gradient is Gradient" % name, g != null, tex.gradient)
	if g == null:
		return
	# §B.3: stops at 0%/15%/70%/100%; colours and alpha from the brief.
	var want := [
		[0.00, Color8(0xD8, 0xCA, 0xB0), 0.0],
		[0.15, Color8(0xE9, 0xDF, 0xC9), 0.8],
		[0.70, Color8(0xEF, 0xE6, 0xD2), 0.7],
		[1.00, Color8(0xD8, 0xCA, 0xB0), 0.0],
	]
	check("%s color_ramp has %d stops" % [name, want.size()],
		g.get_point_count() == want.size(), g.get_point_count())
	for i in want.size():
		var row: Array = want[i]
		var want_t: float = row[0]
		var want_c: Color = row[1]
		var want_a: float = row[2]
		var got_t := g.get_offset(i)
		var got_c := g.get_color(i)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] offset = %.2f" % [name, i, want_t],
			is_equal_approx(got_t, want_t), got_t)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] rgb within 1/255 of %s" % [name, i, _hex6(want_c)],
			_rgb_close(got_c, want_c), got_c)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] alpha = %.2f" % [name, i, want_a],
			is_equal_approx(got_c.a, want_a), got_c.a)

func _check_draw_pass(cp: GPUParticles3D, name: String) -> void:
	var mesh := cp.draw_pass_1 as QuadMesh
	check("%s draw_pass_1 is QuadMesh" % name, mesh != null, cp.draw_pass_1)
	if mesh == null:
		return
	check("%s quad size = (0.07, 0.045) m" % name,
		mesh.size.is_equal_approx(Vector2(0.07, 0.045)), mesh.size)
	var mat := mesh.material as StandardMaterial3D
	check("%s mesh.material is StandardMaterial3D" % name, mat != null, mesh.material)
	if mat == null:
		return
	check("%s material.transparency = ALPHA (1)" % name,
		mat.transparency == BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA, mat.transparency)
	check("%s material.blend_mode = MIX (0)" % name,
		mat.blend_mode == BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_MIX, mat.blend_mode)
	check("%s material.shading_mode = UNSHADED (0)" % name,
		mat.shading_mode == BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED, mat.shading_mode)
	check("%s material.billboard_mode = BILLBOARD_PARTICLES (3)" % name,
		mat.billboard_mode == BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES, mat.billboard_mode)
	check("%s material.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true" % name,
		mat.vertex_color_use_as_albedo == true, mat.vertex_color_use_as_albedo)
	check("%s material.albedo_texture = res://effects/moth.png" % name,
		mat.albedo_texture != null and mat.albedo_texture.resource_path == "res://effects/moth.png",
		mat.albedo_texture)

func _check_attractor(at: GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D, name: String, want_pos: Vector3) -> void:
	check("%s position = %s" % [name, want_pos],
		at.transform.origin.is_equal_approx(want_pos), at.transform.origin)
	check("%s radius = 1.0" % name, is_equal_approx(at.radius, 1.0), at.radius)
	check("%s strength = 0.30" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.strength, 0.30), at.strength)
	check("%s attenuation = 1.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.attenuation, 1.0), at.attenuation)
	check("%s directionality = 0.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.directionality, 0.0), at.directionality)
	check("%s cull_mask = 4294967295 (all layers; won't affect Effect A CPU particles)" % name,
		at.cull_mask == 4294967295, at.cull_mask)

func _rgb_close(a: Color, b: Color) -> bool:
	var tol := 0.5 / 255.0
	return absf(a.r - b.r) <= tol and absf(a.g - b.g) <= tol and absf(a.b - b.b) <= tol

func _hex6(c: Color) -> String:
	return "#%02X%02X%02X" % [int(round(c.r * 255.0)), int(round(c.g * 255.0)), int(round(c.b * 255.0))]

## 10:00 PM (inside NIGHT, before the 1740 cutoff), stands Hari under the middle

## preview seeds (101/202/303) and `use_fixed_seed = true` here only; the effect
## scene itself leaves use_fixed_seed off. At frame 70 the night condition ends and
## all three emitters set `emitting = false`; existing moths fade over the next
## ~72 frames (2.4 s lifetime at 30 fps) and are gone by frame 145 (§E).

const SLICE := preload("res://scenes/slice.tscn")
const MOTHS := preload("res://effects/string_light_moths.tscn")
const HARI_UNDER_BULBS := Vector3(12.0, 0.0, 1.0)  # same spot the scuff preview uses
const HELD_CLOCK := 22 * 60                        # 10:00 PM: NIGHT, before 1740
const ACTIVATE_FRAME := 10
const DEACTIVATE_FRAME := 70                       # §E: condition ends here
const SEEDS := [101, 202, 303]                     # §B.3: preview copies only

var slice: Node3D
var moths: Node3D = null
var _frame := 0

func _ready() -> void:
	slice = SLICE.instantiate()
	add_child(slice)
	LoopState.test_hold_clock = true
	LoopState.test_advance_to(HELD_CLOCK)
	slice.get_node("HUD").visible = false
	var hari: CharacterBody3D = slice.get_node("Hari")
	hari.position = HARI_UNDER_BULBS
	hari.reset_physics_interpolation()
	slice.get_node("CameraRig").snap()

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_frame += 1
	if _frame == ACTIVATE_FRAME:
		_activate()
	elif _frame == DEACTIVATE_FRAME and moths != null:
		for child in moths.get_children():
			if child is GPUParticles3D:

func _activate() -> void:
	moths = MOTHS.instantiate()
	var ei := 0
	for child in moths.get_children():
		if child is GPUParticles3D:
			var cp := child as GPUParticles3D
			cp.use_fixed_seed = true
			cp.seed = SEEDS[ei]
			ei += 1
	slice.add_child(moths)

## Loads res://effects/string_light_moths.tscn and asserts every setting the brief
## names, using the brief's values as the expected values. No rendering, no attractor

##
## The scene references res://effects/moth.png via ext_resource (see §B.3). If the
## PNG is missing the test writes it via the shared tools/moth_texture.gd helper and
## asks for a re-run so Godot's startup filesystem scan imports the new file.

const SCENE := "res://effects/string_light_moths.tscn"
const MT := preload("res://tools/moth_texture.gd")

const EMITTERS := [
	["MothsWest",   Vector3(8.0,  2.85, -3.4)],
	["MothsMiddle", Vector3(12.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
	["MothsEast",   Vector3(16.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
]
const ATTRACTORS := [
	["AttractorWest",   Vector3(8.0,  2.85, -3.4)],
	["AttractorMiddle", Vector3(12.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
	["AttractorEast",   Vector3(16.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
]

func run() -> bool:
	if not ResourceLoader.exists(MT.OUT, "Texture2D"):
		var err := MT.save()
		check("bootstrapped %s via tools/moth_texture.gd (re-run to import)" % MT.OUT,
			err == OK, err)
		print("[INFO] moth.png was missing; re-run this test so Godot's startup scan imports it.")
		return true
	var ps: PackedScene = load(SCENE)
	check("scene loads: %s" % SCENE, ps != null, ps)
	if ps == null:
		return true

	["MothsWest",   Vector3(8.0,  2.85, -3.4)],

		var err := MT.save()
		check("bootstrapped %s via tools/moth_texture.gd (re-run to import)" % MT.OUT,
			err == OK, err)
		print("[INFO] moth.png was missing; re-run this test so Godot's startup scan imports it.")
		return true
	var ps: PackedScene = load(SCENE)
	check("scene loads: %s" % SCENE, ps != null, ps)

extends "res://tests/harness.gd"
## A6 Effect B configuration read-back (CHANGE-BRIEF §B.3, §B.4).
## Loads res://effects/string_light_moths.tscn and asserts every setting the brief
## names, using the brief's values as the expected values. No rendering, no attractor
## solve — the look is checked by frame strips; this test proves the scene file
## matches §B.3. The effect scene has `use_fixed_seed = false` (preview flips it on).
## Run:  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_string_light_moths_config.gd 60

const SCENE := "res://effects/string_light_moths.tscn"

const EMITTERS := [
	["MothsWest",   Vector3(8.0,  2.85, -3.4)],
	["MothsMiddle", Vector3(12.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
	["MothsEast",   Vector3(16.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
]
const ATTRACTORS := [
	["AttractorWest",   Vector3(8.0,  2.85, -3.4)],
	["AttractorMiddle", Vector3(12.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
	["AttractorEast",   Vector3(16.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
]

func run() -> bool:
	var ps: PackedScene = load(SCENE)
	check("scene loads: %s" % SCENE, ps != null, ps)
	if ps == null:
		return true
	var root_node: Node = ps.instantiate()
	check("root is Node3D named StringLightMoths",
		root_node is Node3D and root_node.name == "StringLightMoths",
		"%s / %s" % [root_node.get_class(), root_node.name])
	check("root process_mode = PAUSABLE (1)",
		root_node.process_mode == Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE, root_node.process_mode)
	check("root has 6 children (3 emitters + 3 attractors)",
		root_node.get_child_count() == 6, root_node.get_child_count())

	for row in EMITTERS:
		var name: String = row[0]
		var want_pos: Vector3 = row[1]
		var cp := root_node.get_node_or_null(name) as GPUParticles3D
		check("%s exists and is GPUParticles3D" % name, cp != null, cp)
		if cp == null:
			continue
		_check_emitter_node(cp, name, want_pos)
		_check_process_material(cp, name)
		_check_draw_pass(cp, name)

	for row in ATTRACTORS:
		var name: String = row[0]
		var want_pos: Vector3 = row[1]
		var at := root_node.get_node_or_null(name) as GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D
		check("%s exists and is GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D" % name, at != null, at)
		if at == null:
			continue
		_check_attractor(at, name, want_pos)

	root_node.queue_free()
	await steps(1)
	return true

func _check_emitter_node(cp: GPUParticles3D, name: String, want_pos: Vector3) -> void:
	check("%s position = %s" % [name, want_pos],
		cp.transform.origin.is_equal_approx(want_pos), cp.transform.origin)
	check("%s amount = 12" % name, cp.amount == 12, cp.amount)
	check("%s amount_ratio = 1.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.amount_ratio, 1.0), cp.amount_ratio)
	check("%s one_shot = false" % name, cp.one_shot == false, cp.one_shot)
	check("%s explosiveness = 0.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.explosiveness, 0.0), cp.explosiveness)
	check("%s randomness = 0.4" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.randomness, 0.4), cp.randomness)
	check("%s lifetime = 2.4 s" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.lifetime, 2.4), cp.lifetime)
	check("%s preprocess = 2.4 s" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.preprocess, 2.4), cp.preprocess)
	check("%s fixed_fps = 30" % name, cp.fixed_fps == 30, cp.fixed_fps)
	check("%s speed_scale = 1.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(cp.speed_scale, 1.0), cp.speed_scale)
	check("%s use_fixed_seed = false (effect scene; preview flips it)" % name,
		cp.use_fixed_seed == false, cp.use_fixed_seed)
	check("%s local_coords = false (moths fly in world space)" % name,
		cp.local_coords == false, cp.local_coords)
	check("%s trail_enabled = false" % name,
		cp.trail_enabled == false, cp.trail_enabled)
	check("%s process_mode = PAUSABLE (1)" % name,
		cp.process_mode == Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE, cp.process_mode)
	check("%s visibility_aabb = AABB((-1.5,-1.1,-1.5),(3,2.2,3))" % name,
		cp.visibility_aabb == AABB(Vector3(-1.5, -1.1, -1.5), Vector3(3.0, 2.2, 3.0)),
		cp.visibility_aabb)

func _check_process_material(cp: GPUParticles3D, name: String) -> void:
	var pm := cp.process_material as ParticleProcessMaterial
	check("%s process_material is ParticleProcessMaterial" % name,
		pm != null, cp.process_material)
	if pm == null:
		return
	# Emission
	check("%s pm.emission_shape = EMISSION_SHAPE_BOX (3)" % name,
		pm.emission_shape == ParticleProcessMaterial.EMISSION_SHAPE_BOX, pm.emission_shape)
	check("%s pm.emission_box_extents = (0.65, 0.30, 0.40)" % name,
		pm.emission_box_extents.is_equal_approx(Vector3(0.65, 0.30, 0.40)),
		pm.emission_box_extents)
	# Process
	check("%s pm.direction = (0, 1, 0)" % name,
		pm.direction.is_equal_approx(Vector3(0, 1, 0)), pm.direction)
	check("%s pm.spread = 85 deg" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.spread, 85.0), pm.spread)
	check("%s pm.initial_velocity_min = 0.06" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.initial_velocity_min, 0.06), pm.initial_velocity_min)
	check("%s pm.initial_velocity_max = 0.28" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.initial_velocity_max, 0.28), pm.initial_velocity_max)
	check("%s pm.gravity = (0, 0, 0)" % name,
		pm.gravity.is_equal_approx(Vector3.ZERO), pm.gravity)
	check("%s pm.damping_min = 0.12" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.damping_min, 0.12), pm.damping_min)
	check("%s pm.damping_max = 0.35" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.damping_max, 0.35), pm.damping_max)
	check("%s pm.scale_min = 0.7" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.scale_min, 0.7), pm.scale_min)
	check("%s pm.scale_max = 1.2" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.scale_max, 1.2), pm.scale_max)
	check("%s pm.angle_min = -35 deg" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.angle_min, -35.0), pm.angle_min)
	check("%s pm.angle_max = +35 deg" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.angle_max, 35.0), pm.angle_max)
	check("%s pm.angular_velocity_min = -110 deg/s" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.angular_velocity_min, -110.0), pm.angular_velocity_min)
	check("%s pm.angular_velocity_max = +110 deg/s" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.angular_velocity_max, 110.0), pm.angular_velocity_max)
	check("%s pm.hue_variation_min = -0.03" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.hue_variation_min, -0.03), pm.hue_variation_min)
	check("%s pm.hue_variation_max = +0.03" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.hue_variation_max, 0.03), pm.hue_variation_max)
	check("%s pm.attractor_interaction_enabled = true" % name,
		pm.attractor_interaction_enabled == true, pm.attractor_interaction_enabled)
	# Turbulence
	check("%s pm.turbulence_enabled = true" % name,
		pm.turbulence_enabled == true, pm.turbulence_enabled)
	check("%s pm.turbulence_noise_strength = 0.45" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.turbulence_noise_strength, 0.45), pm.turbulence_noise_strength)
	check("%s pm.turbulence_noise_scale = 5.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.turbulence_noise_scale, 5.0), pm.turbulence_noise_scale)
	check("%s pm.turbulence_noise_speed = (0.15, 0.08, 0.12)" % name,
		pm.turbulence_noise_speed.is_equal_approx(Vector3(0.15, 0.08, 0.12)),
		pm.turbulence_noise_speed)
	check("%s pm.turbulence_noise_speed_random = 0.2" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.turbulence_noise_speed_random, 0.2),
		pm.turbulence_noise_speed_random)
	check("%s pm.turbulence_influence_min = 0.12" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.turbulence_influence_min, 0.12), pm.turbulence_influence_min)
	check("%s pm.turbulence_influence_max = 0.30" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.turbulence_influence_max, 0.30), pm.turbulence_influence_max)
	check("%s pm.turbulence_initial_displacement_min = 0.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.turbulence_initial_displacement_min, 0.0),
		pm.turbulence_initial_displacement_min)
	check("%s pm.turbulence_initial_displacement_max = 0.06" % name,
		is_equal_approx(pm.turbulence_initial_displacement_max, 0.06),
		pm.turbulence_initial_displacement_max)
	_check_scale_curve(pm, name)
	_check_color_ramp(pm, name)

func _check_scale_curve(pm: ParticleProcessMaterial, name: String) -> void:
	# ParticleProcessMaterial wraps the Curve in a CurveTexture.
	var tex := pm.scale_curve as CurveTexture
	check("%s pm.scale_curve is CurveTexture" % name, tex != null, pm.scale_curve)
	if tex == null:
		return
	var c := tex.curve as Curve
	check("%s pm.scale_curve.curve is Curve" % name, c != null, tex.curve)
	if c == null:
		return
	var want: Array[Vector2] = [
		Vector2(0.0, 0.7), Vector2(0.15, 1.0), Vector2(0.75, 1.0), Vector2(1.0, 0.6),
	]
	check("%s scale_curve has %d points" % [name, want.size()],
		c.get_point_count() == want.size(), c.get_point_count())
	for i in want.size():
		var w: Vector2 = want[i]
		var g := c.get_point_position(i)
		check("%s scale_curve[%d] = (life %.2f, scale %.2f)" % [name, i, w.x, w.y],
			g.is_equal_approx(w), g)

func _check_color_ramp(pm: ParticleProcessMaterial, name: String) -> void:
	# ParticleProcessMaterial wraps the Gradient in a GradientTexture1D.
	var tex := pm.color_ramp as GradientTexture1D
	check("%s pm.color_ramp is GradientTexture1D" % name, tex != null, pm.color_ramp)
	if tex == null:
		return
	var g := tex.gradient as Gradient
	check("%s pm.color_ramp.gradient is Gradient" % name, g != null, tex.gradient)
	if g == null:
		return
	# §B.3: stops at 0%/15%/70%/100%; colours and alpha from the brief.
	var want := [
		[0.00, Color8(0xD8, 0xCA, 0xB0), 0.0],
		[0.15, Color8(0xE9, 0xDF, 0xC9), 0.8],
		[0.70, Color8(0xEF, 0xE6, 0xD2), 0.7],
		[1.00, Color8(0xD8, 0xCA, 0xB0), 0.0],
	]
	check("%s color_ramp has %d stops" % [name, want.size()],
		g.get_point_count() == want.size(), g.get_point_count())
	for i in want.size():
		var row: Array = want[i]
		var want_t: float = row[0]
		var want_c: Color = row[1]
		var want_a: float = row[2]
		var got_t := g.get_offset(i)
		var got_c := g.get_color(i)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] offset = %.2f" % [name, i, want_t],
			is_equal_approx(got_t, want_t), got_t)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] rgb within 1/255 of %s" % [name, i, _hex6(want_c)],
			_rgb_close(got_c, want_c), got_c)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] alpha = %.2f" % [name, i, want_a],
			is_equal_approx(got_c.a, want_a), got_c.a)

func _check_draw_pass(cp: GPUParticles3D, name: String) -> void:
	var mesh := cp.draw_pass_1 as QuadMesh
	check("%s draw_pass_1 is QuadMesh" % name, mesh != null, cp.draw_pass_1)
	if mesh == null:
		return
	check("%s quad size = (0.07, 0.045) m" % name,
		mesh.size.is_equal_approx(Vector2(0.07, 0.045)), mesh.size)
	var mat := mesh.material as StandardMaterial3D
	check("%s mesh.material is StandardMaterial3D" % name, mat != null, mesh.material)
	if mat == null:
		return
	check("%s material.transparency = ALPHA (1)" % name,
		mat.transparency == BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA, mat.transparency)
	check("%s material.blend_mode = MIX (0)" % name,
		mat.blend_mode == BaseMaterial3D.BLEND_MODE_MIX, mat.blend_mode)
	check("%s material.shading_mode = UNSHADED (0)" % name,
		mat.shading_mode == BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED, mat.shading_mode)
	check("%s material.billboard_mode = BILLBOARD_PARTICLES (3)" % name,
		mat.billboard_mode == BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_PARTICLES, mat.billboard_mode)
	check("%s material.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true" % name,
		mat.vertex_color_use_as_albedo == true, mat.vertex_color_use_as_albedo)
	check("%s material.albedo_texture = res://effects/moth.png" % name,
		mat.albedo_texture != null and mat.albedo_texture.resource_path == "res://effects/moth.png",
		mat.albedo_texture)

func _check_attractor(at: GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D, name: String, want_pos: Vector3) -> void:
	check("%s position = %s" % [name, want_pos],
		at.transform.origin.is_equal_approx(want_pos), at.transform.origin)
	check("%s radius = 1.0" % name, is_equal_approx(at.radius, 1.0), at.radius)
	check("%s strength = 0.30" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.strength, 0.30), at.strength)
	check("%s attenuation = 1.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.attenuation, 1.0), at.attenuation)
	check("%s directionality = 0.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.directionality, 0.0), at.directionality)
	check("%s cull_mask = 4294967295 (all layers; won't affect Effect A CPU particles)" % name,
		at.cull_mask == 4294967295, at.cull_mask)

func _rgb_close(a: Color, b: Color) -> bool:
	var tol := 0.5 / 255.0
	return absf(a.r - b.r) <= tol and absf(a.g - b.g) <= tol and absf(a.b - b.b) <= tol

func _hex6(c: Color) -> String:
	return "#%02X%02X%02X" % [int(round(c.r * 255.0)), int(round(c.g * 255.0)), int(round(c.b * 255.0))]

##

## PNG is missing the test writes it via the shared tools/moth_texture.gd helper and
## asks for a re-run so Godot's startup filesystem scan imports the new file.

func run() -> bool:

func _check_scale_curve(pm: ParticleProcessMaterial, name: String) -> void:
	# ParticleProcessMaterial wraps the Curve in a CurveTexture.
	var tex := pm.scale_curve as CurveTexture
	check("%s pm.scale_curve is CurveTexture" % name, tex != null, pm.scale_curve)
	if tex == null:
		return
	var c := tex.curve as Curve
	check("%s pm.scale_curve.curve is Curve" % name, c != null, tex.curve)
	if c == null:
		return
	var want: Array[Vector2] = [
		Vector2(0.0, 0.7), Vector2(0.15, 1.0), Vector2(0.75, 1.0), Vector2(1.0, 0.6),
	]
	check("%s scale_curve has %d points" % [name, want.size()],
		c.get_point_count() == want.size(), c.get_point_count())
	for i in want.size():
		var w: Vector2 = want[i]
		var g := c.get_point_position(i)
		check("%s scale_curve[%d] = (life %.2f, scale %.2f)" % [name, i, w.x, w.y],
			g.is_equal_approx(w), g)

func _check_color_ramp(pm: ParticleProcessMaterial, name: String) -> void:
	# ParticleProcessMaterial wraps the Gradient in a GradientTexture1D.
	var tex := pm.color_ramp as GradientTexture1D
	check("%s pm.color_ramp is GradientTexture1D" % name, tex != null, pm.color_ramp)
	if tex == null:
		return
	var g := tex.gradient as Gradient
	check("%s pm.color_ramp.gradient is Gradient" % name, g != null, tex.gradient)
	if g == null:
		return
	# §B.3: stops at 0%/15%/70%/100%; colours and alpha from the brief.
	var want := [
		[0.00, Color8(0xD8, 0xCA, 0xB0), 0.0],
		[0.15, Color8(0xE9, 0xDF, 0xC9), 0.8],
		[0.70, Color8(0xEF, 0xE6, 0xD2), 0.7],
		[1.00, Color8(0xD8, 0xCA, 0xB0), 0.0],
	]
	check("%s color_ramp has %d stops" % [name, want.size()],
		g.get_point_count() == want.size(), g.get_point_count())
	for i in want.size():
		var row: Array = want[i]
		var want_t: float = row[0]
		var want_c: Color = row[1]
		var want_a: float = row[2]
		var got_t := g.get_offset(i)
		var got_c := g.get_color(i)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] offset = %.2f" % [name, i, want_t],
			is_equal_approx(got_t, want_t), got_t)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] rgb within 1/255 of %s" % [name, i, _hex6(want_c)],
			_rgb_close(got_c, want_c), got_c)
		check("%s color_ramp[%d] alpha = %.2f" % [name, i, want_a],
			is_equal_approx(got_c.a, want_a), got_c.a)

func _check_draw_pass(cp: GPUParticles3D, name: String) -> void:

func _check_attractor(at: GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D, name: String, want_pos: Vector3) -> void:
	check("%s position = %s" % [name, want_pos],
		at.transform.origin.is_equal_approx(want_pos), at.transform.origin)
	check("%s radius = 1.0" % name, is_equal_approx(at.radius, 1.0), at.radius)
	check("%s strength = 0.30" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.strength, 0.30), at.strength)
	check("%s attenuation = 1.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.attenuation, 1.0), at.attenuation)
	check("%s directionality = 0.0" % name,
		is_equal_approx(at.directionality, 0.0), at.directionality)
	check("%s cull_mask = 4294967295 (all layers; won't affect Effect A CPU particles)" % name,
		at.cull_mask == 4294967295, at.cull_mask)

func _rgb_close(a: Color, b: Color) -> bool:
	var tol := 0.5 / 255.0
	return absf(a.r - b.r) <= tol and absf(a.g - b.g) <= tol and absf(a.b - b.b) <= tol

func _hex6(c: Color) -> String:
	return "#%02X%02X%02X" % [int(round(c.r * 255.0)), int(round(c.g * 255.0)), int(round(c.b * 255.0))]

func _rgb_close(a: Color, b: Color) -> bool:
	var tol := 0.5 / 255.0

func _hex6(c: Color) -> String:
	return "#%02X%02X%02X" % [int(round(c.r * 255.0)), int(round(c.g * 255.0)), int(round(c.b * 255.0))]

## A6 Effect B configuration read-back (CHANGE-BRIEF §B.3, §B.4).
## Loads res://effects/string_light_moths.tscn and asserts every setting the brief
## names, using the brief's values as the expected values. No rendering, no attractor
## solve — the look is checked by frame strips; this test proves the scene file
## matches §B.3. The effect scene has `use_fixed_seed = false` (preview flips it on).
## Run:  ./scripts/run-test.sh test_string_light_moths_config.gd 60
##
## The scene references res://effects/moth.tres via ext_resource (see §B.3 and the
## note in tools/moth_texture.gd about why the scene loads the .tres, with the .png
## still committed next to it). If either artifact is missing the test writes them
## both via the shared helper before loading the scene.

const SCENE := "res://effects/string_light_moths.tscn"
const MT := preload("res://tools/moth_texture.gd")

const EMITTERS := [
	["MothsWest",   Vector3(8.0,  2.85, -3.4)],
	["MothsMiddle", Vector3(12.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
	["MothsEast",   Vector3(16.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
]
const ATTRACTORS := [
	["AttractorWest",   Vector3(8.0,  2.85, -3.4)],
	["AttractorMiddle", Vector3(12.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
	["AttractorEast",   Vector3(16.0, 2.85, -3.4)],
]

func run() -> bool:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(MT.OUT_PNG) or not FileAccess.file_exists(MT.OUT_TRES):
		var err := MT.save_all()
		check("bootstrapped %s and %s via tools/moth_texture.gd" % [MT.OUT_PNG, MT.OUT_TRES],
			err == OK, err)
	var ps: PackedScene = load(SCENE)
	check("scene loads: %s" % SCENE, ps != null, ps)
	if ps == null:
		return true
	var root_node: Node = ps.instantiate()
	check("root is Node3D named StringLightMoths",
		root_node is Node3D and root_node.name == "StringLightMoths",
		"%s / %s" % [root_node.get_class(), root_node.name])
	check("root process_mode = PAUSABLE (1)",
		root_node.process_mode == Node.PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE, root_node.process_mode)
	check("root has 6 children (3 emitters + 3 attractors)",
		root_node.get_child_count() == 6, root_node.get_child_count())

	for row in EMITTERS:
		var name: String = row[0]
		var want_pos: Vector3 = row[1]
		var cp := root_node.get_node_or_null(name) as GPUParticles3D
		check("%s exists and is GPUParticles3D" % name, cp != null, cp)
		if cp == null:
			continue
		_check_emitter_node(cp, name, want_pos)
		_check_process_material(cp, name)
		_check_draw_pass(cp, name)

	for row in ATTRACTORS:
		var name: String = row[0]
		var want_pos: Vector3 = row[1]
		var at := root_node.get_node_or_null(name) as GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D
		check("%s exists and is GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D" % name, at != null, at)
		if at == null:
			continue
		_check_attractor(at, name, want_pos)

	root_node.queue_free()
	await steps(1)
	return true

func _hex6(c: Color) -> String:

Effect B is built, configured, and verified. Here's the state:

**Config test** — `./scripts/run-test.sh test_string_light_moths_config.gd 60` → **253/253 PASS** (log at `logs/test_string_light_moths_config_60fps.log`). It reads back every brief §B.3/§B.4 setting from the loaded scene: all three emitter positions, the shared `ParticleProcessMaterial` (emission/process/turbulence), the `scale_curve` (CurveTexture→Curve) and `color_ramp` (GradientTexture1D→Gradient) stops, the `QuadMesh` + `StandardMaterial3D` draw pass, and all three `GPUParticlesAttractorSphere3D` nodes. The trailing `RendererDummy` RID-leak line is a known headless-dummy cleanup warning, not a test failure.

**Files added**
- `godot/effects/string_light_moths.tscn` — root `StringLightMoths` (PAUSABLE) with `MothsWest/Middle/East` at (8/12/16, 2.85, −3.4) each paired with an `AttractorWest/Middle/East` at the same position; one shared `ParticleProcessMaterial` carrying the brief's process/turbulence values + the scale `CurveTexture` and the cream `GradientTexture1D`; draw pass is a `QuadMesh` of size (0.07, 0.045) using a `StandardMaterial3D` (alpha mix, unshaded, particle billboard, vertex_color_use_as_albedo). `use_fixed_seed` stays off in the effect scene.
- `godot/effects/moth.tres` — the ImageTexture the scene actually references via `ext_resource`. The scene loads a `.tres` rather than `.png` because headless `--script` doesn't run Godot's PNG-import pass, so the ext_resource for the PNG would never resolve.
- `godot/effects/moth.png` — committed next to the effect per brief, regenerated from the same pixel formula.
- `godot/tools/moth_texture.gd` — static helper (`generate() / save_png() / save_tres() / save_all()`), the single source of truth for the pixel formula.
- `godot/tools/write_moth_texture.gd` — SceneTree entry: `godot --headless --path godot -s res://tools/write_moth_texture.gd` writes both PNG and TRES.
- `godot/tests/test_string_light_moths_config.gd` — bootstraps both artifacts on first run if missing, then runs 253 read-back assertions.
- `godot/previews/string_light_moths_preview.{tscn,gd}` — instances the real `res://scenes/slice.tscn` (level, sky, lights, Hari, camera rig), holds the clock at 10:00 PM (NIGHT, before 1740), hides the HUD, stands Hari under the middle span, activates the effect at frame 10 (turning `use_fixed_seed` on with seeds 101/202/303 **on the preview instance only**), deactivates at frame 70 (§E).

**Uncertainty** — I can't confirm against the engine that `ParticleProcessMaterial.color_ramp` in 4.7.2 is strictly `GradientTexture1D` (it accepts other GradientTexture subtypes too); the test asserts the exact wrapper type used by the scene and passed, so for this build it holds, but the stronger "any texture whose .gradient matches" check isn't made.

**Capture command for the preview** (Movie Maker, 30 fps, windowed as noted in CLAUDE.md — you run it; the preview deactivates at frame 70, predictions extend to frame 145):

```bash
godot --path godot --write-movie evidence/a6/string_light_moths_preview.avi \
      --fixed-fps 30 --resolution 1280x720 \
      res://previews/string_light_moths_preview.tscn
```

Stopping here per the instructions — no gameplay wiring, no shader edits, no commit.

python3 -I -c '
import struct, zlib, math
W, H = 64, 40
rows = []
for y in range(H):
    row = bytearray([0])
    for x in range(W):
        nx = (x + 0.5 - W * 0.5) / (W * 0.5)
        ny = (y + 0.5 - H * 0.5) / (H * 0.5)
        left_dx = nx + 0.42
        right_dx = nx - 0.42
        wy = ny - 0.05
        left_d  = math.sqrt(left_dx*left_dx*6.0  + wy*wy*3.2)
        right_d = math.sqrt(right_dx*right_dx*6.0 + wy*wy*3.2)
        wing = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - min(left_d, right_d)))
        wing *= wing
        body_d = math.sqrt(nx*nx*70.0 + ny*ny*5.5)
        body = max(0.0, min(1.0, 1.0 - body_d))
        alpha = max(0.0, min(1.0, wing + body))
        if alpha <= 0.02:
            row += bytes([0,0,0,0]); continue
        body_w = body / (body + wing + 0.0001)
        gray = 1.0*(1.0-body_w) + 0.32*body_w
        g = int(round(gray*255)); a = int(round(alpha*255))
        row += bytes([g,g,g,a])
    rows.append(bytes(row))
raw = b"".join(rows)
def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack(">I", len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(t+d) & 0xffffffff)
sig = b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
ihdr = struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", W, H, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0)
idat = zlib.compress(raw, 9)
png = sig + chunk(b"IHDR", ihdr) + chunk(b"IDAT", idat) + chunk(b"IEND", b"")
open("godot/effects/moth.png","wb").write(png)
print("wrote godot/effects/moth.png", W, "x", H, len(png), "bytes")
'
